cover.title: the founder whose team is half ai agents

inner.title: give it one job
inner.body: anthropic's agent guide says find the simplest solution and add complexity only when needed. sometimes that means no agent at all.
inner.label: maybe no agent

inner.title: test in a sandbox
inner.body: anthropic recommends testing agents in a sandbox, with guardrails, before they act alone. more autonomy means errors compound.
inner.label: watch it first

inner.title: investors count humans
inner.body: carta data shows solo founders started 30% of 2024 startups. they got just 14.7% of priced-round cash.

inner.title: time it, don't feel it
inner.body: in metr's 2025 trial, 16 experienced developers expected ai to save them 24%. it made them 19% slower.
inner.label: 19% slower

inner.title: cut the pricey ones
inner.body: gartner predicts over 40% of agentic ai projects get canceled by the end of 2027. the reasons: rising costs, unclear value, weak risk controls.
inner.label: cut first
